如何接入AVSession实现音视频应用的统一播控管理
如何实现音视频投播到远端设备（Cast+和DLNA）
如何实现后台音频播放并确保不被系统暂停
如何使用投播组件AVCastPicker接入投播功能
如何使用音频模板快速接入播控中心
如何实现桌面歌词悬浮窗展示
如何进行应用接入播控功能的自检验证
如何实现扩展屏投播场景
当开发音视频播放应用时，请接入AVSession Kit以实现统一的媒体播放控制
应用接入后，用户可通过系统播控中心查看和控制播放状态，提升用户体验
当应用需要实现后台音频播放时，必须接入AVSession并配合Background Tasks Kit的长时任务，否则退到后台后将被强制暂停
当应用需要将音视频内容投播到远端设备（如电视、音箱）时，请使用AVSession Kit的音视频投播能力和投播组件AVCastPicker
当应用需要以悬浮窗形式在桌面显示歌词时，请使用桌面歌词功能
当希望通过音频模板减少播控接入的开发工作量时，请使用音频模板
接入系统媒体控制，让锁屏和通知栏可以控制播放暂停 / Integrate system media controls so lock screen and notifications can play and pause media
实现耳机线控和蓝牙按键控制音视频播放 / Handle headset remote buttons and Bluetooth media keys for playback
同步当前歌曲信息、封面和播放进度到系统播控卡片 / Sync track metadata, artwork, and playback progress to the system media card
注册 MediaSession 让多个播放器状态统一受系统管理 / Register a media session so player state is managed consistently by the system
实现后台继续播歌并响应系统的上一首下一首指令 / Keep audio playing in background and respond to previous/next commands from the system
把应用播放器接入播控中心显示标题、歌手和专辑封面 / Connect the app player to the control center to show title, artist, and album art
添加投屏按钮，把当前视频投送到电视或音箱播放 / Add a cast button to send the current video to a TV or speaker
实现从手机切换到远端设备继续播放并同步播放状态 / Transfer playback from phone to a remote device and keep playback state in sync
管理播放队列和跳转上一曲下一曲的系统控制事件 / Manage the playback queue and handle system previous/next track events
在锁屏界面展示正在播放内容并支持快进快退 / Show now playing content on the lock screen with seek forward and backward support
接入 AVCastPicker 让用户选择可投播的设备 / Integrate AVCastPicker so users can choose available cast devices
实现桌面歌词悬浮显示并随播放进度实时更新 / Show floating desktop lyrics and update them in real time with playback
适配系统音频焦点和中断事件，来电时自动暂停后恢复 / Handle system audio focus and interruptions, pausing for calls and resuming afterward
为音频或视频应用接入统一播控面板和会话生命周期管理 / Add a unified playback control panel and session lifecycle management for an audio or video app
do_not_use_when: 需求是音频采集、播放渲染、音效处理或音频路由，而非媒体会话/播控中心接入时，应改用 audio-kit / If the task is audio capture, playback rendering, audio effects, or audio routing rather than media-session/control-center integration, use audio-kit instead

需求是音视频编解码、封装解封装、转码或流媒体处理，而非统一播控或投播管理时，应改用 avcodec-kit / If the task is audio/video encoding-decoding, muxing-demuxing, transcoding, or stream processing rather than unified playback control or casting management, use avcodec-kit instead
需求是拍照、录像、相机预览或相机设备控制，而非媒体会话管理时，应改用 camera-kit / If the task is photo capture, video recording, camera preview, or camera device control rather than media session management, use camera-kit instead

需求是访问媒体文件库、查询相册/音视频资产或读写系统媒体资源，而非播控会话时，应改用 media-library-kit / If the task is accessing the media library, querying album/audio-video assets, or reading-writing system media resources rather than playback sessions, use media-library-kit instead

需求是图片编解码、编辑、显示处理，或通用媒体播放录制能力而不是系统级播控中心接入时，应分别改用 image-kit 或 media-kit / If the task is image encoding-decoding, editing, display processing, or general media playback/recording rather than system-level control-center integration, use image-kit or media-kit respectively instead
preconditions: 工程已引入并启用 AVSession Kit 对应能力，所用 API 版本在目标 HarmonyOS SDK 中可用 / The project has added and enabled AVSession Kit capability, and the required APIs are available in the target HarmonyOS SDK

若要实现后台持续播放，应用已同时接入 Background Tasks 长时任务相关配置，否则退到后台可能被系统暂停 / For continuous background playback, the app has also integrated long-running task configuration from Background Tasks; otherwise playback may be paused when sent to background
若要使用投播能力，设备与目标端满足 Cast+ 或 DLNA 发现/连接条件，相关网络环境可用 / To use casting, the device and target endpoint satisfy Cast+ or DLNA discovery/connection requirements and the network environment is available
若要展示桌面歌词，应用已具备系统桌面悬浮展示所需的窗口/权限前置条件 / To show desktop lyrics, the app already meets the window/permission prerequisites required for floating display on the system desktop
inputs: 媒体会话配置 / media session configuration
播放状态与媒体元数据（如标题、封面、时长） / playback state and media metadata (such as title, artwork, duration)
播控命令回调或控制器请求 / playback-control callbacks or controller requests
投播目标设备信息或投播组件上下文 / cast target device information or cast-picker component context

postconditions.statement: 代码中已创建并接入 AVSession，会话能够承载媒体元数据与播放状态更新 / The code creates and integrates an AVSession that can carry media metadata and playback state updates
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set show AVSession-related APIs/classes being added and wired so a media session is created or obtained and updated with playback information?

postconditions.statement: 代码中已注册或处理系统播控命令，使应用可被播控中心、语音助手或控制器统一控制 / The code registers or handles system playback-control commands so the app can be controlled by Control Center, voice assistant, or controllers
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set include handling or registration for play/pause/seek/next/previous or similar AVSession control callbacks/controllers?

postconditions.statement: 若实现后台播放，修改中同时体现了 AVSession 与后台长时任务的协同接入 / If background playback is implemented, the changes also reflect coordinated integration of AVSession and long-running background task support
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the task mentions background playback, do the edits include both AVSession integration and background long-running task/keep-alive related setup rather than only one side?

postconditions.statement: 若实现投播，修改中接入了投播能力或 AVCastPicker 等统一投播组件 / If casting is implemented, the changes integrate casting capability or the unified AVCastPicker component
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the task mentions casting, do the edits add AVSession casting-related APIs, device-selection flow, or AVCastPicker integration?
